record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Does there exist a complete Boolean algebra B such that its Scott space Sigma B=(B, sigma(B)) is non-sober?

evidence.quote: Question 3.7. Is there a complete Boolean algebra that has a non-sober Scott topology?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $B$ be a complete Boolean algebra, i.e., a Boolean algebra in which every subset has a supremum (and hence an infimum). Recall that for a poset $(P,\le)$, a subset $U\subseteq P$ is Scott open if (i) $U$ is an upper set (i.e., $x\in U$ and $x\le y$ imply $y\in U$) and (ii) for every directed subset $D\subseteq P$ whose supremum $\bigvee D$ exists and lies in $U$, there exists $d\in D$ with $d\in U$. The collection $\sigma(B)$ of all Scott-open sets is a topology on $B$, and the resulting topological space $\Sigma B=(B,\sigma(B))$ is called the Scott space of $B$. A topological space $X$ is sober if every nonempty irreducible closed subset of $X$ is the closure of a unique point of $X$ (a closed set $C$ is irreducible if $C=C_1\cup C_2$ with $C_1,C_2$ closed implies $C=C_1$ or $C=C_2$).

Question: Does there exist a complete Boolean algebra $B$ such that the Scott space $\Sigma B$ is not sober?
artifact.status_search_result: The analogous question for complete Heyting algebras was answered positively by Xu, Xi and Zhao (2019), who constructed a complete Heyting algebra with non-sober Scott space, resolving a problem of Jung. However, the strictly stronger version for complete Boolean algebras does not appear to have been settled in the available literature; no construction or non-existence proof for the Boolean case was found.

status_evidence.title: A complete Heyting algebra whose Scott space is non-sober
status_evidence.snippet: There is a complete Heyting algebra whose Scott space is non-sober, answering a problem posed by Jung.
status_evidence.claim: The Heyting-algebra analogue is solved, but the Boolean-algebra case is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: When do weakly first-countable spaces and the Scott topology of open set lattice become sober?
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work continues to investigate sufficient conditions for sobriety of Scott topologies on complete lattices.
status_evidence.claim: Sobriety of Scott topologies on complete lattices is an active research topic with related questions still being studied.
